proof_body:
by
  have hnn : ∀ (a b x : ℝ), 0 < a → 0 < b → 0 ≤ ProbabilityTheory.betaPDFReal a b x := by
    intro a b x ha hb
    by_cases hx : 0 < x ∧ x < 1
    · exact (ProbabilityTheory.betaPDFReal_pos hx.1 hx.2 ha hb).le
    · simp [ProbabilityTheory.betaPDFReal, if_neg hx]
  have pdf_int : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 < a → 0 < b → MeasureTheory.Integrable (ProbabilityTheory.betaPDFReal a b) ∧ ∫ x, ProbabilityTheory.betaPDFReal a b x = 1 := by
    intro a b ha hb
    have e : ProbabilityTheory.betaPDFReal a b = fun x => (ProbabilityTheory.betaPDF a b x).toReal := by
      funext x
      rw [ProbabilityTheory.betaPDF, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hnn a b x ha hb)]
    have hm : Measurable (ProbabilityTheory.betaPDF a b) := (ProbabilityTheory.measurable_betaPDFReal a b).ennreal_ofReal
    rw [e]
    refine ⟨MeasureTheory.integrable_toReal_of_lintegral_ne_top hm.aemeasurable ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [ProbabilityTheory.lintegral_betaPDF_eq_one ha hb]; exact ENNReal.one_ne_top
    · rw [MeasureTheory.integral_toReal hm.aemeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top), ProbabilityTheory.lintegral_betaPDF_eq_one ha hb]; rfl
  have key_int : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < a → 0 < b → (MeasureTheory.Integrable g (ProbabilityTheory.betaMeasure a b) ↔ MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ProbabilityTheory.betaPDFReal a b x * g x)) ∧ ∫ x, g x ∂(ProbabilityTheory.betaMeasure a b) = ∫ x, ProbabilityTheory.betaPDFReal a b x * g x := by
    intro a b g ha hb
    have e : ∀ x, (ProbabilityTheory.betaPDF a b x).toReal = ProbabilityTheory.betaPDFReal a b x := fun x => by
      rw [ProbabilityTheory.betaPDF, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hnn a b x ha hb)]
    have hm : Measurable (ProbabilityTheory.betaPDF a b) := (ProbabilityTheory.measurable_betaPDFReal a b).ennreal_ofReal
    constructor
    · rw [ProbabilityTheory.betaMeasure, MeasureTheory.integrable_withDensity_iff_integrable_smul₀' hm.aemeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)]
      simp only [e, smul_eq_mul]
    · rw [ProbabilityTheory.betaMeasure, integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul₀ hm.aemeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)]
      simp only [e, smul_eq_mul]
  have mom : ∀ (a b s : ℝ), 0 < a → 0 < b → 0 ≤ s → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ s) (ProbabilityTheory.betaMeasure a b) ∧ ∫ x, x ^ s ∂(ProbabilityTheory.betaMeasure a b) = ProbabilityTheory.beta (a + s) b / ProbabilityTheory.beta a b := by
    intro a b s ha hb hs
    have has : 0 < a + s := by linarith
    have hB := ProbabilityTheory.beta_pos ha hb
    have hB' := ProbabilityTheory.beta_pos has hb
    have e : (fun x : ℝ => ProbabilityTheory.betaPDFReal a b x * x ^ s) = fun x => (ProbabilityTheory.beta (a + s) b / ProbabilityTheory.beta a b) * ProbabilityTheory.betaPDFReal (a + s) b x := by
      funext x
      by_cases hx : 0 < x ∧ x < 1
      · simp only [ProbabilityTheory.betaPDFReal, if_pos hx]
        rw [show a + s - 1 = (a - 1) + s by ring, Real.rpow_add hx.1]
        field_simp
      · simp [ProbabilityTheory.betaPDFReal, if_neg hx]
    rw [(key_int a b _ ha hb).1, (key_int a b _ ha hb).2, e]
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := pdf_int (a + s) b has hb
    refine ⟨h1.const_mul _, ?_⟩
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, h2, mul_one]
  intro a b ha hb
  have : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (ProbabilityTheory.betaMeasure a b) := ProbabilityTheory.isProbabilityMeasureBeta ha hb
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := mom a b 1 ha hb zero_le_one
  obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := mom a b 2 ha hb zero_le_two
  simp only [Real.rpow_one] at h1 h2
  simp only [Real.rpow_two] at h3 h4
  have hL : MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun x : ℝ => x) 2 (ProbabilityTheory.betaMeasure a b) :=
    (MeasureTheory.memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq measurable_id.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr h3
  have hab := add_pos ha hb
  have h7 : Real.Gamma (a + 1) = a * Real.Gamma a := Real.Gamma_add_one ha.ne'
  have h8 : Real.Gamma (a + 2) = (a + 1) * (a * Real.Gamma a) := by
    rw [show a + 2 = (a + 1) + 1 by ring, Real.Gamma_add_one (by positivity), h7]
  have h9 : Real.Gamma (a + 1 + b) = (a + b) * Real.Gamma (a + b) := by
    rw [show a + 1 + b = (a + b) + 1 by ring, Real.Gamma_add_one hab.ne']
  have h10 : Real.Gamma (a + 2 + b) = (a + b + 1) * ((a + b) * Real.Gamma (a + b)) := by
    rw [show a + 2 + b = (a + b + 1) + 1 by ring, Real.Gamma_add_one (by positivity), Real.Gamma_add_one hab.ne']
  have h3' := (Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos ha).ne'
  have h4' := (Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos hb).ne'
  have h5 := (Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos hab).ne'
  have h6 := hab.ne'
  have h11 : a + b + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hmean : ∫ x, x ∂(ProbabilityTheory.betaMeasure a b) = a / (a + b) := by
    rw [h2, ProbabilityTheory.beta, ProbabilityTheory.beta, h7, h9]
    field_simp
  refine ⟨hL, hmean, ?_⟩
  rw [ProbabilityTheory.variance_eq_sub hL]
  simp only [Pi.pow_apply]
  rw [hmean, h4, ProbabilityTheory.beta, ProbabilityTheory.beta, h8, h10]
  field_simp
  ring
target_source: ∀ (a b : ℝ), 0 < a → 0 < b → MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun x : ℝ => x) 2 (ProbabilityTheory.betaMeasure a b) ∧ ∫ x, x ∂(ProbabilityTheory.betaMeasure a b) = a / (a + b) ∧ ProbabilityTheory.variance (fun x : ℝ => x) (ProbabilityTheory.betaMeasure a b) = a * b / ((a + b) ^ 2 * (a + b + 1))
